name: The Literal Easter Egg
area: Top of the tallest tower in Vice City proper
summary: A bird's nest of painted eggs sits at the very top of Vice City's tallest tower. Take one and throw it.
details: Rockstar's joke on the term: a real egg, painted like an Easter egg, waiting in a nest at the summit of the city's tallest tower.
Either protagonist can pick it up and throw it. Players say throwing it kicks off a surprise vehicle-strike cutscene.
steps: Head downtown and find the tallest tower in Vice City proper. At night, look for the highest set of red aircraft-warning lights.
Climb all the way up. Reports put the climb at roughly six to seven minutes, so don't fall.
Walk to the nest, take an egg, and throw it.

name: A Certain Forensic Analyst's Apartment
area: Washington Island, near the Vice Beach Top Fun Drones shop
summary: A near-faithful recreation of Dexter Morgan's apartment complex from the TV series, open from the start of the game.
details: Fans of the Miami-set crime drama will recognize the building straight away. One guide rates it about 90% faithful to the show's version.
It sits on Washington Island, a Vice City subregion, close to the Top Fun Drones shop on Vice Beach. You can drive to Vice City before the story takes you there.
steps: Cross to Washington Island in Vice City.
Look for the Vice Beach Top Fun Drones shop; the apartment complex is nearby.

sources.label: GameSpot — GTA 6 Easter eggs and where to find them

name: Kelly County UFO Encounter
area: Somewhere in Kelly County (fan-mapped around Port Gellhorn)
summary: Players report a hidden alien encounter in Kelly County after Chapter 1, most reliably late at night.
details: Early players say a UFO event can trigger in Kelly County once you have finished the first chapter.
It reportedly only happens at night, most reliably after 2:00 a.m. on the in-game clock. The exact trigger spot hasn't been pinned down, so the circle shows the whole search area.
steps: Drive into Kelly County after dark. Check the time on your phone (D-pad up).
Wait for 2:00 a.m. in-game and explore the open country. If it fails, try a different night.

name: Grassrivers Underwater Stashes
area: Deeper channels and pools of the Grassrivers
summary: Map guides report explorable underwater areas in the Grassrivers that hold treasure and secrets.
details: Pre-launch map roundups describe underwater spaces in the wetlands worth diving for.
Exact stash points haven't been charted yet. Gators share the water, so dive from a boat and keep an eye on your surroundings.
steps: Take a boat into the wider channels.
Dive near wrecks, pilings and drop-offs; that's where loot usually sits.

sources.label: allthings.how — Every confirmed region in Leonida

name: Gators & Flamingos
summary: Alligators and flamingos have been spotted across the Grassrivers. Great photos, bad swimming.
details: Wildlife is one of Leonida's signatures, and the wetlands are where you'll see the most of it.
Players are already sharing surprising animal encounters. Treat any shoreline as gator territory.

name: Downtown Rooftop Sweep
area: Downtown Vice City rooftops and helipads
summary: Where to look first for hidden collectibles: series tradition loves rooftops, helipads and ledges.
details: This is an inference, not a find. Hidden packages and collectibles in the series have long clustered on rooftops and hard-to-reach ledges.
Downtown Vice City has the most of both. Grab a helicopter, or start from the tower climb for the egg nest.
steps: Work the tallest buildings first, then the parking-garage roofs.
Check the world map: darker blue buildings have interiors and often roof access.

name: Keys Reef & Wreck Dive
area: Shallow reefs along the island chain
summary: A prime spot to check for sunken loot. Earlier games hid wrecks and treasure offshore.
details: Inference: Leonida leans hard on water, and past entries rewarded divers with wrecks and hidden pieces offshore.
The Keys' shallow reefs are the most obvious place to start sweeping.
steps: Rent or steal a boat at a marina.
Sweep the reef line slowly. Look for hull shapes and debris fields.

name: Summit Mystery Watch
summary: GTA V hid its most famous mystery on its tallest mountain. Mount Kalaga's peak is the natural first stop.
details: Pure theory, flagged as such: nothing has been found here yet.
Mysteries in the series often depend on time and weather, so go at night, in fog or storms, and check every lookout and mural.
steps: Head for the highest point in the park.
Return at night and in bad weather. Note anything that changes.

name: Bigfoot of Gullet Marsh
area: Gullet Marsh (position on the map not yet charted)
summary: Bigfoot is back. A close encounter in Gullet Marsh happens during a particular story mission, so you can't miss it.
details: This one is part of a mission, not a free-roam secret.
We haven't pinned Gullet Marsh on the map yet. If you know where it is, send us the spot.

sources.label: GameSpot — GTA 6 Easter eggs and where to find them

name: Jason's House
area: Starting safehouse (position on the map not yet charted)
summary: Your first base. Stash cash under the bedroom floorboards, feed Dolores the snake, sleep to skip time.
details: Until the mission "Buck Me" unlocks a bank account, the loose floorboards in Jason's bedroom are the safe place for cash. Money you carry is at risk if you die or get arrested.
Feed Jason's pet snake, Dolores, and watch her eat for an early Focus Mode buff.
Sleeping here moves the clock on. Use it to start night jobs on your schedule. There's also a book on the small table by the back door (see below).

name: The Liberty City Saga Continues
area: Jason's house, small table near the back door
summary: Books around Leonida keep a Liberty City storyline going. The first one is in Jason's home early in Chapter 1.
details: Check the literature lying around homes and businesses. The first example sits on the small table near Jason's back door.
More copies turn up across the state.
steps: Early in Chapter 1, explore Jason's home and read the book on the table by the back door.

sources.label: GameSpot — GTA 6 Easter eggs and where to find them

name: Cowboy Novels from the West
area: Various; one is in Jacob's Tavern in Millport
summary: Western novels about a cowboy in New Austin: a wink to Rockstar's frontier series. One is at Jacob's Tavern in Millport.
details: Pick up and read the westerns you find around the state. The cowboy tales will be familiar to anyone who rode through New Austin.
We haven't charted Millport on the map yet. Pins welcome.
steps: Visit Jacob's Tavern in Millport and look for the novel.
